Researchers find microplastics in Indonesian sea salt, contaminating a pantry staple

"Tests on sea salt sold in markets across Indonesia's Lombok Island found microplastics in every sample, suggesting that a kitchen staple used worldwide is carrying signs of ocean pollution."
